summary: Most requested functional changes appear implemented: Event Details now refetches fresh event data via React Query settings/invalidation (REQ-16), Location is not shown on Event Details (REQ-17), events support multiple sports end-to-end (REQ-18), and date range is introduced in backend types and frontend adapter/pages with range display logic (REQ-19).
